topics.text: Nestled in the lush mountains, the hotel offers breathtaking views and a serene environment. The unique setting, with its surrounding bamboo forests, provides a peaceful retreat, perfect for relaxation and connecting with nature.

The hotel offers a variety of amenities that enhance the guest experience, including a private onsen, KTV room, and a pool. These facilities are well-maintained and provide additional options for relaxation and entertainment during the stay.

The hotel is noted for its cleanliness and well-maintained rooms. The bedding is comfortable, and the overall atmosphere of the rooms is described as cozy and inviting, contributing to a restful stay.

suggestion.text: Some customers suggest improving room hygiene and pest control, as well as enhancing the quality and comfort of mattresses, to better match the pricing expectations.

address: No. 6, Ganmiaowu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: An excellent B&B! The environment is beautiful and comfortable, and the lobby staff were very attentive. I'll definitely come back next time!
